name: Calldetenes (Spain)
description: White field with three green pears set two and one in the upper hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 20 August 1993 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1792 of 3 September 1993; it is an oblong white flag of 2:3 with three green pears, each 1/6 of the height, set two and one and centred in an imaginary square at the upper hoist of side 1/2 of the height, reproducing the figures of the arms.

features.role: pears set two and one within a square of 1/2 of the height at the upper hoist
